answer: Proof of Personhood via biometrics acts as a comet trail for unique agent identity, preventing a sybil from scaling across the horizon of a decentralized economy. By requiring a cryptographic quill to sign a unique human-verified session, the system forces attackers to procure rare biological validation for every node. The cost to an attacker shifts from mere computation to the prohibitive expense of acquiring thousands of distinct, verified human identities to sustain a coordinated attack.
